summary: First full run. Backend 14/14 pytest pass (register/login/me/save GET-PUT-DELETE, 401/409/413/422 paths). Frontend (390x844 web preview) all requested flows verified end-to-end: title -> auth (login/register tabs + error msgs) -> Inizia Avventura -> intro (3 taps, name, starter) -> /game; D-pad movement (1 step per ~100ms press, collisions + NPC blocking OK); exits Bologna->Osteria Grande (15,8) and back, Bologna->Ferrara (7,0) and back; Sfoglina heal (toast 'Squadra curata!'); shop modal buy vasetto/brodino (money/items decrement correct); trainer Studente battle: flee & catch correctly blocked, LOSE flow (respawn at lastHeal 2,13, money halved, party healed) and WIN flow (+60 EUR, defeated=['bo_studente'], after-lines on re-talk, no rebattle); wild grass encounter + catch (3 vasetti used, mon added to party, caught/seen updated); team screen brodino/in testa/cantina/porta in squadra; Mostrario count + 4 filter chips; Salva ora, Schermata iniziale, reload -> session persisted -> Continua restored exact position; Nuova partita cancel/confirm (cloud save deleted) and logout; deep link /game while logged out redirects to title. No page errors, clean expo/backend logs. Main finding: game balance - first trainer (adjacent to spawn) is practically unbeatable with a fresh starter (simulated win rate 0.7%-9.9%). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: No account deletion endpoint, so TEST_ users created during testing cannot be cleaned up (test_ui63446@example.com and pytest test_<hex>@example.com users remain).

ui_bugs.issue: team-msg is never cleared/updated by 'In testa' (lead) or 'Cantina' (toBox) actions, so stale 'X beve il brodino' text stays shown after other actions. Reference: /app/frontend/app/team.tsx:35-46

Menu 'Schermata iniziale' does router.replace('/') from /game, which was pushed on top of '/', leaving TWO title screens mounted in the stack (2 [data-testid=title-screen] in DOM, one hidden). Android back from title goes to another title. Use router.dismissTo('/') / router.back() instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx:259

integration_issues.issue: GameContext load .catch(() => setSaveState(null)) treats a network/5xx error on GET /api/save as 'no save', so title shows 'Inizia Avventura' and starting a new game will PUT over the user's existing cloud save (data-loss risk). Should show an error/retry state instead. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/GameContext.tsx:95

issues: Studente Fuorisede at (8,7), right next to spawn, has Squacquerone L4 + Mortazzone L5; a lone L5 starter loses almost always. Monte-Carlo sim mirroring engine.ts (tests/sim_first_trainer.py): Tortellotto 0.7%, Fanghino 6.9%, Grappolino 9.9% win rate. Reproduced in UI: lost in 4 turns with Tortellotto. Squacquerone also knows Spruzzo di Fango (terme, 2x vs sugo starter). Suggest a single L3 mon for the first trainer and/or in-battle Brodino use.
No way to use Brodino (healing item) during battle - only Lotta/Cattura/Mostri/Fuga; combined with the balance above makes trainer fights very punishing.
Camera not clamped to map bounds: near edges large black void areas (up to ~1/3 of map viewport) e.g. at Sfoglina (2,13) or Osteria entry (1,8).
Hint text 'A parla · B menu' 11px muted gray - low readability.
Italian articles: 'Un Squacquerone selvatico' / 'Il Squacquerone' should be 'Uno/Lo' before s+consonant (and z, gn, ps). Minor localization polish in Battle.tsx:36,75.

action_items: Rebalance first trainer Studente Fuorisede (data.ts:120) - e.g. team [['squacquerone',3]] or move fango learn level of squacquerone higher; consider allowing Brodino in battle.
game.tsx:259 replace router.replace('/') with router.dismissTo('/') (or back()) to avoid duplicate title screens in stack.
GameContext.tsx:95 differentiate load error from empty save (show error + retry, don't allow overwriting).
team.tsx: clear/set msg in lead() and toBox(); optionally prevent boxing the last healthy monster.
Optional: clamp overworld camera to map edges; fix Italian articles (Uno/Lo Squacquerone).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend is clean: Pydantic validation, bcrypt, JWT with exp, _id excluded, unique indexes, proper 401/409/413/422.
onBattleEnd does n.defeated = [...n.defeated, npc.id] without dedupe; if onEnd ever fires twice reward/defeated duplicate. Use Set for safety.
team.tsx toBox allows moving the only healthy monster to Cantina, leaving a party of fainted monsters (interact then refuses battles; wild encounter check prevents battles) - edge case.
Battle catch keeps the caught mon's current (damaged) HP - fine, just noting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional (balance/design issues reported separately)

rca_of_issue: First-trainer loss: Lv5 starter HP 19; Squacquerone L4 (18HP, fango 2x vs Tortellotto) + Mortazzone L5 (22HP) deal ~6-7 per hit while starter deals ~7-9; cumulative damage > 19 HP before both faint. Reproduced via UI and sim.
